rows.text: In his address of Wednesday 24 January 2001 the Prime Minister announces that the King 'in - Privy Council today' consented to ministerial appointments 'with effect from 24th January, 2001', the second being 'Hon. Tevita P. Tupou' as 'Deputy Prime Minister & The Attorney General & Minister of Justice'.
